description: How an observed effect was established. Only methods with `sufficient_for_confirmed` may support a CONFIRMED confirmation state; a downstream acknowledgement supports COMMITTED only.

entries.description: The downstream system acknowledged receipt or acceptance of the request.
The protected state was read back from the system of record after the write.
An authoritative event from the downstream system reported the effect.
A reconciliation process matched the effect against authoritative records.
The downstream system issued a signed receipt for the effect.
An independent external party attested to the effect.
An authorized person validated the effect against the system of record.
